name: Swedish Orphan Biovitrum AB (publ)
summary: Swedish Orphan Biovitrum AB (publ), a biopharma company, provides medicines in the areas of haematology, immunology, and specialty care in Europe, North America, the Middle East, Asia, and Australia. The company operates through three segments: Haematology, Immunology, and Specialty Care. It offers Alprolix for haemophilia B; ALTUVOCT for the treatment and prophylaxis of bleeding in patients with haemophilia A; Aspaveli/Empaveli for treating adult patients with paroxysmal nocturnal haemoglobinuria; Doptelet for the treatment of immune thrombocytopenia and thrombocytopenia; Elocta/Eloctate for the treatment and prophylaxis of bleeding in patients with haemophilia A; Gamifant for treating hemo…
